description: Connect ChatGPT to Meku workspaces and project workflows through Meku's remote MCP server.

defaultPrompt: Connect to Meku and show me which workspaces I can access.
Help me find and inspect a Meku project.
Help me build or update a project in Meku.
interface.longDescription:
Meku is an AI web app and website builder that turns simple prompts into full-stack web apps and sites.

With this plugin, Codex can work inside your Meku workspace: start a project from a prompt, keep refining it in conversation, review changes, set up a database, and deploy when you're ready.

What you can do:
- Create a new app or website from a short description
- Make changes and review the diff before you ship
- Turn on a database and add connectors to your app
- Deploy to a live URL
- Track how your project is doing with built-in analytics
- Save reusable skills for your workspace

Try asking:
"Build a booking page for a dental clinic with a contact form."
"What changed in my last edit?"
"Deploy my portfolio project."

You'll need a Meku account.

name: meku-mcp
